c. Issue any other writ, direction or order which deems fit under the circumstances of the case.

2. The petitioner claims to the owner of 19 acres in SY.No.322 of Diggaon Village, Chittapur Taluk,
Kalaburagi District.
The acquisition of the said lands having been initiated by notification under Section 28(1) the Karnataka Industrial Area Development Act (KIAD Act) on 12.6.1981.

entities.text: Karnataka Industrial Area Development Act (KIAD Act)
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: During the process of determination of compensation there being rival claimants.

The land acquisition officer by order dated 27.9.1982 had recommended the reference of the matter under Section 30 of the Land Acquisition Act 1894 to the Civil Court for determination of the interse rights between the rival claimants.
3. Despite the same, no reference had been made.
It is in that background that the petitioner is before this Court seeking for the aforesaid reliefs.
It is rather strange that though an order for reference has been made on 27.9.1982, it is not implemented.

In that view of the matter, I pass the following;
 ORDER  i.
The writ petition is allowed.

ii. A mandamus is issued, directing respondents No.3 and 4 to implement the order dated 27.9.1982 at Annexure-B by forwarding the file to the appropriate Jurisdictional Court within a period of thirty days from the date of receipt the copy of this order.
